name: Snake - tkinter game with high scores and an autopilot

GRID_W = 24
GRID_H = 18
CELL = 24
START_DELAY_MS = 150
MIN_DELAY_MS = 60
SPEEDUP_EVERY = 4        # foods eaten per speed-up
SPEEDUP_MS = 10
HIGHSCORE_FILE = "highscores.json"

import random
import unittest
from collections import deque

from snake import config
from snake.game import DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP, Game


class GameTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make(self):
        return Game(10, 10, rng=random.Random(1))

    def test_moves_one_cell_per_step(self):
        game = self.make()
        start = game.head
        game.step()
        self.assertEqual(game.head, (start[0] + 1, start[1]))
        self.assertEqual(len(game.body), 3)

    def test_eating_grows_and_scores(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.food = (game.head[0] + 1, game.head[1])
        game.step()
        self.assertEqual(game.score, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(game.body), 4)
        self.assertNotIn(game.food, game.body)

    def test_cannot_reverse(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.turn(LEFT)
        game.step()
        self.assertEqual(game.direction, RIGHT)

    def test_quick_double_turn_cannot_reverse(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.turn(UP)
        game.turn(LEFT)
        game.step()
        self.assertTrue(game.alive)
        self.assertEqual(game.direction, UP)

    def test_wall_kills(self):
        game = self.make()
        for _ in range(10):
            game.step()
        self.assertFalse(game.alive)

    def test_running_into_itself_kills(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.body = deque([(5, 5), (6, 5), (6, 4), (5, 4), (4, 4)])
        game.direction = game._pending = LEFT
        game.food = (0, 0)
        game.turn(UP)
        game.step()
        self.assertFalse(game.alive)

    def test_chasing_the_tail_is_allowed(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.body = deque([(5, 5), (6, 5), (6, 4), (5, 4)])
        game.direction = game._pending = LEFT
        game.food = (0, 0)
        game.turn(UP)
        game.step()
        self.assertTrue(game.alive)

    def test_speeds_up_but_has_a_floor(self):
        game = self.make()
        self.assertEqual(game.delay_ms, config.START_DELAY_MS)
        game.score = config.SPEEDUP_EVERY * 2
        self.assertEqual(game.delay_ms, config.START_DELAY_MS - 2 * config.SPEEDUP_MS)
        game.score = 1000
        self.assertEqual(game.delay_ms, config.MIN_DELAY_MS)

    def test_dead_snake_stays_put(self):
        game = self.make()
        game.alive = False
        before = list(game.body)
        game.step()
        self.assertEqual(list(game.body), before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import random
import unittest
from collections import deque

from snake import ai
from snake.game import DOWN, RIGHT, UP, Game


class AiTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_does_not_drive_into_a_wall(self):
        game = Game(10, 10, rng=random.Random(2))
        game.body = deque([(9, 5), (8, 5), (7, 5)])
        game.food = (0, 0)
        choice = ai.choose(game)
        self.assertIn(choice, (UP, DOWN))

    def test_heads_for_the_food(self):
        game = Game(10, 10, rng=random.Random(2))
        game.food = (game.head[0] + 3, game.head[1])
        self.assertEqual(ai.choose(game), RIGHT)

    def test_autopilot_survives_a_while(self):
        game = Game(12, 12, rng=random.Random(3))
        for _ in range(60):
            game.turn(ai.choose(game))
            game.step()
        self.assertTrue(game.alive)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import argparse
import tkinter as tk

from snake.ui import SnakeApp


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Snake")
    parser.add_argument("--demo", action="store_true",
                        help="let the computer play for a few seconds")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = tk.Tk()
    SnakeApp(root, demo=args.demo)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Snake

Classic Snake with a tkinter window, high scores and a computer-played demo.

    python play.py          # arrows or WASD, space = pause / restart, Esc = quit
    python play.py --demo   # watch the autopilot for 12 seconds
    python -m unittest -v
